# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 13 fs-frontier3, the frontier programme (part A, steps 4-5: backers, annuity, redemption, settlement). Generated by gen_frontier.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================================================================== part A steps 4 and 5 (design 3.3.2, 3.3.3)
# BYZ scope, monthly (oe_fs_monthly_all, after part A's month): January's contracts; the lazy sweep of ended contracts;
# then at most one of oe_fs.13 / .14 for a programme of oe_fs_done (none while oe_fs.12, .13 or .14 is open; it waits
# for the main-line lock at most 6 months, and not while war reaches the region); a programme whose region is lost
# leaves the list (it may open again; a contract it signed lives on).
oe_fs_b_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_fs_b_january = yes }
    oe_fs_kc_sweep = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_e13 NOT = { oe_fs_ev_13 = yes } } oe_fs_e13_clear = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_e14 NOT = { oe_fs_ev_14 = yes } } oe_fs_e14_clear = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_e12 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_e13 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_e14 } }
        random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_done limit = { var:oe_fs_stage ?= 4 NOT = { oe_fs_c_held = yes } } save_scope_as = oe_fs_lc }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_lc } oe_fs_b_drop = yes }
        else = {
            random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_done limit = { oe_fs_c_due = yes } save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_pc }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_pc_paused = yes } }
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_bw } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bw value = 0 } }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_bw add = 1 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_fs_bw > 6 } }
                        remove_variable = oe_fs_bw
                        if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_pc = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk } } oe_fs_send_14 = yes }
                        else = { oe_fs_send_13 = yes }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = { remove_variable = oe_fs_bw }
        }
    }
    oe_fs_b_recount = yes
}
# BYZ scope, January: each live contract pays its year; then the AI's redemption roll (design 3.3.3: 30 %).
oe_fs_b_january = {
    oe_fs_b_pay_all = yes
    if = { limit = { is_ai = yes gold >= 1000 } random = { chance = 30 oe_fs_ai_redeem = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. The yearly annuity of every live contract (the BYZ list oe_fs_bk_list; ended ones carry no oe_fs_bk_live).
oe_fs_b_pay_all = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_bk_list
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live }
        save_scope_as = oe_fs_kc
        c:BYZ = { oe_fs_pay_one = yes }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_kc = a contract's centre. One January: a void contract ends; otherwise the due and the arrears
# are paid whole (into the Company's fund for kt 3) or the due is added to the arrears (Authority -1, the house
# +5 influence, the Company +3 autonomy); the house's yearly +3; the year counts; after 20 years with no
# arrears the contract ends (oe_fs_bk_end 1).
oe_fs_pay_one = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_kc_void = yes }
        oe_fs_kc_end = { why = 3 }
    }
    else = {
        scope:oe_fs_kc = {
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_due value = oe_fs_due_c }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_tot value = oe_fs_tot_c }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_fs_tot > 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { gold >= scope:oe_fs_tot }
                add_gold = { value = scope:oe_fs_tot multiply = -1 }
                if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_kt ?= 3 } } oe_cmp_fs_repay = { amt = scope:oe_fs_tot } }
                scope:oe_fs_kc = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_debt value = 0 } }
            }
            else = {
                scope:oe_fs_kc = { change_variable = { name = oe_fs_debt add = scope:oe_fs_due } }
                oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = -1 }
                oe_fs_kc_inf = { amount = 5 }
                if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_kt ?= 3 } } oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 3 } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_bn < 20 } }
            oe_fs_kc_inf = { amount = 3 }
            scope:oe_fs_kc = { change_variable = { name = oe_fs_bn add = 1 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_bn >= 20 var:oe_fs_debt <= 0 } } oe_fs_kc_end = { why = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_kc; amount. The contract's house (kt 1) gains influence (the first maker's own effect, by slot).
oe_fs_kc_inf = {
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_kt ?= 1 } exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_hs ?= 1 } has_variable = oe_nf_influence_1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_hs ?= 2 } has_variable = oe_nf_influence_2 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_hs ?= 3 } has_variable = oe_nf_influence_3 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_kc = { var:oe_fs_hs ?= 4 } has_variable = oe_nf_influence_4 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_kc; why = 1 paid out, 2 redeemed, 3 void. The contract ends (the list entry goes in the sweep).
oe_fs_kc_end = {
    scope:oe_fs_kc = {
        remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_live
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_end value = $why$ }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Ended contracts leave the list, a few a month (never while the list is being walked).
oe_fs_kc_sweep = {
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_bk_list limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } } save_scope_as = oe_fs_kx1 }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_kx1 } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_list target = scope:oe_fs_kx1 } }
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_bk_list limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } } save_scope_as = oe_fs_kx2 }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_kx2 } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_list target = scope:oe_fs_kx2 } }
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_bk_list limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } } save_scope_as = oe_fs_kx3 }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_kx3 } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_list target = scope:oe_fs_kx3 } }
}
# BYZ scope. The counters the texts and the action read (oe_fs_bk_n, _due, _debt, oe_fs_wait4_n) and each contract's
# redemption price (oe_fs_rprice on its centre).
oe_fs_b_recount = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_n value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_due value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_debt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_wait4_n value = 0 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_bk_list
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rprice value = oe_fs_redeem_price }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_d1 value = oe_fs_due_c }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_d2 value = var:oe_fs_debt }
        c:BYZ = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_n add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_due add = scope:oe_fs_d1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk_debt add = scope:oe_fs_d2 }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_done
        limit = { var:oe_fs_stage ?= 4 }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_fs_wait4_n add = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_lc. The empire lost the whole region of a parked programme: it leaves oe_fs_done (the region
# may open again; a contract it signed lives on: oe_fs_kt, oe_fs_bn, oe_fs_debt stay).
oe_fs_b_drop = {
    scope:oe_fs_lc = {
        remove_variable = oe_fs_stage
        remove_variable = oe_fs_r2
        remove_variable = oe_fs_r3
        remove_variable = oe_fs_bk
        remove_variable = oe_fs_s5
    }
    remove_list_variable = { name = oe_fs_done target = scope:oe_fs_lc }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_lost_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_lost_n value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_lost_n add = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. The best house on the register (the most influence; design 3.3.3) -> oe_fs_hs_pick (1-4; none: removed).
oe_fs_pick_house = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_hs_pick
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hbest value = -1 }
        if = { limit = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hi value = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars.var:oe_nf_influence_1 } if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_hi > var:oe_fs_hbest } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hbest value = var:oe_fs_hi } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hs_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hi value = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars.var:oe_nf_influence_2 } if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_hi > var:oe_fs_hbest } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hbest value = var:oe_fs_hi } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hs_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hi value = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars.var:oe_nf_influence_3 } if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_hi > var:oe_fs_hbest } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hbest value = var:oe_fs_hi } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hs_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hi value = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars.var:oe_nf_influence_4 } if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_hi > var:oe_fs_hbest } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hbest value = var:oe_fs_hi } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hs_pick value = 4 } } }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_hi
        remove_variable = oe_fs_hbest
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc = the centre. The sender of oe_fs.13: the region, the house, the monastery's place (the
# region's most populous place of ours).
oe_fs_send_13 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_e13 value = scope:oe_fs_pc }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_e13_reg value = scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region }
    oe_fs_pick_house = yes
    remove_variable = oe_fs_mk_at
    ordered_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_fs_mq }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_mq } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_mk_at value = scope:oe_fs_mq } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fs.13
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. The sender of oe_fs.14: the region, the place that will carry oe_fs_settled (the centre

# place of ours in the region and which may begin now (oe_fs_rw = its number; none: removed).
oe_fs_send_14 = {

# BYZ scope. oe_fs.13 is answered or no longer valid.
oe_fs_e13_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_e13
    remove_variable = oe_fs_e13_reg
    remove_variable = oe_fs_hs_pick
    remove_variable = oe_fs_mk_at
}
# BYZ scope. oe_fs.14 is answered or no longer valid.
oe_fs_e14_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_e14
    remove_variable = oe_fs_e14_reg
    remove_variable = oe_fs_e14_at
    remove_variable = oe_fs_rw
}
# BYZ scope. The worker oe_fs.92: jobs 41-45 the options of oe_fs.13, 51-52 those of oe_fs.14, 61 the redemption.
oe_fs_b_work = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_bjob var:oe_fs_bjob >= 41 var:oe_fs_bjob <= 45 oe_fs_ev_13 = yes }
        var:oe_fs_e13 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_bjob = 41 } oe_fs_bk_house = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_bjob = 42 } oe_fs_bk_monk = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_bjob = 43 } oe_fs_bk_cmp = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_bjob = 44 } oe_fs_bk_self = yes }
        else = { oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 5 } }
        oe_fs_e13_clear = yes
        oe_fs_b_recount = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_bjob var:oe_fs_bjob >= 51 var:oe_fs_bjob <= 52 oe_fs_ev_14 = yes }
        var:oe_fs_e14 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_bjob = 51 } oe_fs_rw_start = yes }
        oe_fs_close = yes
        oe_fs_e14_clear = yes
        oe_fs_b_recount = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_bjob ?= 61 }
        var:oe_fs_rd_at ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_rc }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_rd_at
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_rc } oe_fs_redeem_do = yes }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 61 } }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_bjob
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc; k = the backer (1 house, 2 monastery, 3 Company, 4 treasury, 5 nobody). Step 4 answered;
# step 5 is due 120 months later.
oe_fs_bk_set = {
    scope:oe_fs_pc = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bk value = $k$ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_s5 value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 120 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc; kt = 1 house or 3 Company. A contract begins (BYZ list oe_fs_bk_list; years paid 0).
oe_fs_kc_open = {
    scope:oe_fs_pc = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_kt value = $kt$ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_bn value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_debt value = 0 }
        set_variable = oe_fs_bk_live
        remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_end
    }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_fs_bk_list target = scope:oe_fs_pc }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. The backed region: the empire's land in it gains oe_fs_backed (20 years).
oe_fs_backed_mark = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_backed years = 20 mode = replace }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. a: the house the sender picked pays 200 now; a contract (kt 1, its slot oe_fs_hs).
# The house left the register meanwhile: nobody (aerr 42).
oe_fs_bk_house = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_house_ok = yes oe_fs_kc_free = yes }
        add_gold = 200
        scope:oe_fs_pc = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_hs value = c:BYZ.var:oe_fs_hs_pick } }
        oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 1 }
        oe_fs_kc_open = { kt = 1 }
        oe_fs_backed_mark = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 42 }
        oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 5 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. b: the monasteries pay 150, no return; their place gains oe_fs_monk_loc (20 years, only a
# place of ours); the clergy a little more satisfied.
oe_fs_bk_monk = {
    add_gold = 150
    var:oe_fs_mk_at ?= {
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_monk_loc years = 20 mode = replace } }
    }
    add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
    oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 2 }
    oe_fs_backed_mark = yes
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. c: the Roman Company's fund lends 200 through ITS effect oe_cmp_fs_lend (hook E); self-
# check: the gold arrived, else nobody (aerr 41). A contract (kt 3).
oe_fs_bk_cmp = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_g1 value = { value = gold add = 199 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_fs_cmp_ok = yes oe_fs_kc_free = yes } oe_cmp_fs_lend = { amt = 200 } }
    if = {
        limit = { gold > scope:oe_fs_g1 }
        oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 3 }
        oe_fs_kc_open = { kt = 3 }
        oe_fs_backed_mark = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 41 }
        oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 5 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. d: the treasury pays 150; Authority +2.
oe_fs_bk_self = {
    if = {
        limit = { gold >= 150 }
        add_gold = -150
        oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = 2 }
        oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 4 }
        oe_fs_backed_mark = yes
    }
    else = { oe_fs_bk_set = { k = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. oe_fs.14 a: the movement the sender found (oe_fs_rw), the first maker's own starter (it checks itself);
# self-check: the movement's started trigger holds afterwards (aerr 51 if not).
oe_fs_rw_start = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 1 } oe_rw_start_africa_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_africa_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 2 } oe_rw_start_albania_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_albania_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 3 } oe_rw_start_armenia_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_armenia_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 4 } oe_rw_start_britain_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_britain_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 5 } oe_rw_start_bulgaria_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_bulgaria_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 6 } oe_rw_start_dacia_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_dacia_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 7 } oe_rw_start_egypt_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_egypt_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 8 } oe_rw_start_gaul_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_gaul_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 9 } oe_rw_start_georgia_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_georgia_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 10 } oe_rw_start_german_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_german_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 11 } oe_rw_start_griko_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_griko_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 12 } oe_rw_start_iberia_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_iberia_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 13 } oe_rw_start_illyria_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_illyria_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 14 } oe_rw_start_kudoyr_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_kudoyr_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 15 } oe_rw_start_latin_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_latin_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 16 } oe_rw_start_mesopotamia_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_mesopotamia_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 17 } oe_rw_start_serbia_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_serbia_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 18 } oe_rw_start_syria_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_syria_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 19 } oe_rw_start_paeones_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_paeones_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_rw ?= 20 } oe_rw_start_turkish_romanization = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_rw_turkish_romanization_started = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 51 } } }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Step 5 done: the settled mark (only a place of ours), stage 5 (the region does not open
# again), out of oe_fs_done into the BYZ list oe_fs_closed.
oe_fs_close = {
    var:oe_fs_e14_at ?= {
        if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_settled years = 200 mode = replace } }
    }
    scope:oe_fs_pc = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_stage value = 5 }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_s5
    }
    remove_list_variable = { name = oe_fs_done target = scope:oe_fs_pc }
    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_fs_closed target = scope:oe_fs_pc }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_closed_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_closed_n value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_closed_n add = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_rc = a contract's centre. The redemption (action and AI): its price (oe_fs_redeem_price) paid
# whole (into the Company's fund for kt 3); the contract ends (oe_fs_bk_end 2). Not enough gold or no live contract:
# nothing (aerr 61).
oe_fs_redeem_do = {
    scope:oe_fs_rc = { save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_rp value = oe_fs_redeem_price } save_scope_as = oe_fs_kc }
    if = {
        # review-a: the contract is already void (the Company nationalised or wound up, the house gone): it ends free.
        limit = { scope:oe_fs_rc = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } oe_fs_kc_void = yes }
        oe_fs_kc_end = { why = 3 }
        oe_fs_b_recount = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_fs_rc = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } gold >= scope:oe_fs_rp }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_fs_rp multiply = -1 }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_rc = { var:oe_fs_kt ?= 3 } } oe_cmp_fs_repay = { amt = scope:oe_fs_rp } }
        scope:oe_fs_rc = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_kc }
        oe_fs_kc_end = { why = 2 }
        oe_fs_b_recount = yes
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_aerr value = 61 } }
}
# BYZ scope. The AI redeems one live contract (it pays as the action does).
oe_fs_ai_redeem = {
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_bk_list limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } save_scope_as = oe_fs_rc }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_rc } oe_fs_redeem_do = yes }
}
# ======================================================================== steps 4 and 5: readout and test helpers (test page 30)
# BYZ scope. One debug_log line (fsablog): waiting at steps 4-5, the open events, closed, contracts, the year's due,
# arrears, the error code, and one contract (region, kind, years paid, arrears, redemption price).
oe_fs_b_log = {
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_bk_list limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk_live } save_scope_as = oe_fs_lk }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_lk }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_l_reg value = scope:oe_fs_lk.var:oe_theme_region }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_l_kt value = scope:oe_fs_lk.var:oe_fs_kt }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_l_bn value = scope:oe_fs_lk.var:oe_fs_bn }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_l_debt value = scope:oe_fs_lk.var:oe_fs_debt }
        scope:oe_fs_lk = { save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_fs_lrp value = oe_fs_redeem_price } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_l_rp value = scope:oe_fs_lrp }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_fs A45 wait4=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_wait4_n')|0] e13=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_e13f')|0] e14=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_e14f')|0] closed=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_closed_n')|0] contracts=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_bk_n')|0] due=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_bk_due')|0] debt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_bk_debt')|0] aerr=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_aerr')|0] bw=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_bw')|0] | one contract: reg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_l_reg')|0] kind=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_l_kt')|0] (1 house, 3 company) years=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_l_bn')|0] debt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_l_debt')|0] price=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_l_rp')|0]"
    remove_variable = oe_fs_l_reg
    remove_variable = oe_fs_l_kt
    remove_variable = oe_fs_l_bn
    remove_variable = oe_fs_l_debt
    remove_variable = oe_fs_l_rp
}
# BYZ scope. fsae13: oe_fs.13 at once for a programme waiting at step 4; with none, slot 1 is parked first (its step 3
# result "not done", r3 7).
oe_fs_test_ae13 = {
    oe_fs_e13_clear = yes
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_done limit = { var:oe_fs_stage ?= 4 NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_bk } } save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_fs_pc } has_variable = oe_fs_p1 }
        var:oe_fs_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_p1_r2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_p1_r2 value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_e12 ?= 1 } oe_fs_e12_clear = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_r3
        oe_fs_park_1 = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_pc } oe_fs_send_13 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs A45 test: no programme waits at step 4 and slot 1 is empty (press fsaopen first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsae14: oe_fs.14 at once for a programme that has answered oe_fs.13 (its ten years cut short).
oe_fs_test_ae14 = {
    oe_fs_e14_clear = yes
    random_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_done limit = { var:oe_fs_stage ?= 4 has_variable = oe_fs_bk } save_scope_as = oe_fs_pc }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_pc }
        scope:oe_fs_pc = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_s5 value = oe_ml_month_now } }
        oe_fs_send_14 = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs A45 test: no programme has answered oe_fs.13 yet (press fsae13 and choose first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsayear: January's annuity now (no AI roll), then the readout.
oe_fs_test_ayear = {
    oe_fs_b_pay_all = yes
    oe_fs_kc_sweep = yes
    oe_fs_b_recount = yes
    oe_fs_b_log = yes
}
# BYZ scope. fsaredeem: one live contract is redeemed at its price (as the action does), then the readout.
oe_fs_test_aredeem = {
    oe_fs_b_recount = yes
    oe_fs_ai_redeem = yes
    oe_fs_b_log = yes
}
# BYZ scope. fsacmp: may the Roman Company back a programme now (hook E in the mod: yes)?
oe_fs_test_acmp = {
    if = { limit = { oe_fs_cmp_ok = yes } set_variable = oe_fs_zc }
    debug_log = "oe_fs A45 company: interface=1 (1 = hook E is in) ok=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_zcf')|0] (1 = oe_fs.13 c is offered: charter b or c, a fund of 200 or more)"
    remove_variable = oe_fs_zc
}
# BYZ scope. fsaclr (called first by oe_fs_test_areset): forget steps 4-5 (modifiers and the gold already moved stay;
# closed regions may open again).
oe_fs_test_breset = {
    oe_fs_e13_clear = yes
    oe_fs_e14_clear = yes
    every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_done remove_variable = oe_fs_bk remove_variable = oe_fs_s5 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_bk_list
        remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_live
        remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_end
        remove_variable = oe_fs_kt
        remove_variable = oe_fs_hs
        remove_variable = oe_fs_bn
        remove_variable = oe_fs_debt
        remove_variable = oe_fs_rprice
    }
    clear_variable_list = oe_fs_bk_list
    every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_closed remove_variable = oe_fs_stage remove_variable = oe_fs_r2 remove_variable = oe_fs_r3 remove_variable = oe_fs_bk }
    clear_variable_list = oe_fs_closed
    remove_variable = oe_fs_bw
    remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_due
    remove_variable = oe_fs_bk_debt
    remove_variable = oe_fs_wait4_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_closed_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_rd_at
    remove_variable = oe_fs_bjob
}
